Name: Garten of Dewdew
Author: thylakjoy
Description:
[b]Welcome to Banban's kindergarten!

◇──◆──◇──◆

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (Can't mod without it!)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (Needed to load everything!)

This mod is only compatible with 1.6!

◇──◆──◇──◆[/b]

You can adopt Case 10, The Bird, as a barn animal.

Opila Bird gives you Pink cake. Tarta Bird gives you chocolate cake. (Opila and Tarta mean "cake" in other languages.)
They both drop Givanium at 50 points of friendship. Both birds take 10 days to mature.

◇──◆──◇──◆

My commissions are open on my [b][url=https://ko-fi.com/thylak]Ko-fi[/url]﻿[/b] page if you would like to see me make something else.

◇──◆──◇──◆

[u][b]Givanium Giftability [/b][/u][s](iPad kid tierlist)[/s]
[spoiler]Love: Krobus, Maru, Vincent, Jas
Like: Abigail, Sam
Neutral: Sebastian, Demetrius, Wizard
Dislike: Harvey, Leo
Hate: Caroline, Evelyn, Willy, George, Haley, Elliott, Linus, Lewis[/spoiler]
◇──◆──◇──◆

So far, this mod only adds the Opila and Tarta birds from Garten of Banban as barn animals.

I do want to make this an NPC expansion (particularly of Bittergiggle and Banban) eventually when I have time (I was procrastinating on Subway to Stardew making this). This is my first mod adding farm animals and custom items. I have not fully playtested this because I shouldn't be spending too much time on this. Also because I kind of got too scared of my own creation to spend more time with this.

Downloads.Description: Just the Birds. Reuploaded and added a bug fix for Givanium being misspelled and hence causing errors!
